item.thaumicconcilium.burdening_amulet.d: Your creatures attack what you look at. Feeds on temporary warp; a carved pumpkin blinds its gaze
item.thaumicconcilium.casting_bracelet.d: Worn or in the shield slot: cast key (V) casts. In hand: a wand
item.thaumicconcilium.casting_bracelet.v: Casts instant spells ten at once, at triple cooldown
item.thaumicconcilium.dump_jackboots.des: Sneak with a block in hand to tower upwards
item.thaumicconcilium.elemental_surfer_s: While sneaking, unleashes the elements, paid in vis from a wand on the hotbar
item.thaumicconcilium.primordial_life.de: You've never held anything more pleasant in your hands than this.
item.thaumicconcilium.ring_of_blustering: Lets you command the Spotlight, Alchemist's Spree and Warp Extraction.
item.thaumicconcilium.runic_windings.des: Refills runic shielding by 5 a second. Vis discount 3%
item.thaumicconcilium.shard_mill.desc: Sneak + use: lid. Sneak + mouse wheel: choose shard
item.thaumicconcilium.tight_belt.desc: Wrings temporary warp out of you, leaking flux gas
message.thaumicconcilium.bracelet_shield: Your shield arm is busy: only shield foci cast past a shield
message.thaumicconcilium.hex_no_vis: The hex needs %1$s ordo and %1$s terra vis in your wand
message.thaumicconcilium.lithographer_no: The Lithographer needs 100 ignis, 100 ordo, 50 aqua and 100 aer vis in your wand
message.thaumicconcilium.no_ring: The life force of a mere mortal is insufficient to control such power.
message.thaumicconcilium.no_warp: You are drained out of misery, for now...
message.thaumicconcilium.oblivion_respon: It seems to you that you have forgotten something about...
message.thaumicconcilium.polishment_fail: The infusion unravels: it needed a polished draw from a crystal
research.thaumicconcilium.alchemist_spre: Man himself is weak; it was association that gave him a chance to survive in this cruel world. Your new source of energy has provided the key to a way to unite your friends' forces as effectively as never before. No longer is it necessary for the whole crowd to allocate objectives, navigate the battlefield, and interfere with each other's crossfire or even friendly fire. All that is required from now on is to concentrate all your men's fire on the one whose accuracy you trust the most, and the focus will help him control that cumulative power by perfecting, or modifying, the surrounding projectiles.

While channelled, projectiles that reach me are re-forged and sent out along my aim: snowballs become frost shards, eggs hatch taint spiders, small fireballs become explosive ones and eldritch orbs become an eldritch ray. Primal Essence strengthens them further. Requires the Ring of Blustering Light.
research.thaumicconcilium.astral_monitor:
Status update

Weeks of mental convulsions did not pass without a trace. At one point, a new worm began to bite your consciousness: "How are my friends now?", "Are they all right?".
Seeking reassurance, you turned to your recent accomplishment. The hexagonal mystical construct, standing at the maximum depth you could reach, appeared capable of capturing essences from the environment, and causing the captured rift to "resonate" with it. It was decided to use vis condensers to disperse the essence by directing their output vertically upwards.

In this state, the rift begins to actively react to the objects around it, damaging them to some extent, but at the same time - renewing them.
The matter affected by the void must remain isolated from other objects throughout the process, otherwise it will overload the structure and cause the rift to collapse as soon as possible.
It is possible to remove sent essentia via attempt to dematerialize containted rift.

The solution to your new problem came about in just this way. The thaumometer that touched the void allowed you to look through matter at the state of sentient beings.
To concretize the monitor indications, press Shift+RMB to place a thing associated with the right person in the monitor, his xylographed wand will fit just right.

Throw a Thaumometer onto a Hex of Predictability whose rift holds 128 sensus, 128 vacuos and 64 cognitio. Sneak and use the monitor to open its slot, which takes a xylographed wand; held in the main hand it reads that player's health, mana (with Botania) and runic shielding every half second and shows them as constellation glyphs over its screen.
research.thaumicconcilium.bottle_of_clea:
You can fill bottles with alchemically pure water, for later scattering.
Good at extinguishing burning friends, and is also a good weapon against blazes.
research.thaumicconcilium.bottle_of_thic:
The transformation of your entire region into a contagious cesspool is slow but sure.
But something is clearly missing.
Ah, of course! We need to add more toxic exhaust and poisonous fibers!
Thrown, it bursts into a cloud that gives Flux Taint to every living, untainted creature within five blocks, and seeds the ground around with taint fibres, flux gas and ecological pressure.
research.thaumicconcilium.burdening_amul:
During one of your walks through the desert of souls, a smoldering phantom appeared in front of you, and before it disintegrated into smoke, it told you a general description of a certain jewelry.
There is no doubt that this artifact does not come from our world, but its true origin is still a mystery to you. You've seen nothing like that, neither on the members of the Crimson Cult, nor on the mysterious figures guarding the floating obelisks.

As soon as the amulet was around your neck, you felt the back of your head fill with lead, which almost made you fall, while your vision blurred. You shifted your eyes to the insect crawling by, and it immediately fell backwards, then your head felt lighter.
It looks like you might find a use for this thing before you decide to just take it off.
After a few days, the harshness of your gaze penetrated everyone in your entourage - from loyal wolves to brothers in arms, each of them began to understand your orders instantly, just to avoid drawing attention to themselves unnecessarily.

My gaze turns on everything I look at, my own creatures too. A carved pumpkin over my face blinds it: the amulet still drinks my warp and my creatures still go where I look, but they do the killing.

Polished Infusion: needs 64 Sensus drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.casting_bracel:
A wand you wear

A wand need not be a rod in the hand. Bent into a band about the wrist, a capped core still holds and channels vis, if rather less of it.

Worn on the wrist, it leaves both hands free: press the cast key (V unless I change it) to cast, hold it to channel or charge, and use the change-focus key with no wand in hand to choose its focus. Its casts cost two thirds of a wand's and cool down in half the time, but it holds far less vis. The iron bracelet holds 10 vis; the thaumium one, 20.
research.thaumicconcilium.concilium.stag:
Thaumaturgy does not stay in the laboratory. It changes the people who practise it, the people who fear it, and the people who would profit from it. Some of my colleagues have formed a concilium of sorts: they trade knowledge, signal one another across the wilds, and watch for those who have gone too far.
I should learn their methods.
The concilium's foci are refinements of tools I already know, rebuilt to work alongside the parts I inscribe in my focal manipulator. Each can also be bound, ready-made, onto a blank focus.
It would be reckless enough to try to create something hard to grasp from the start, with untested technology.
Weakening the destructive power of the freeze wand focus was not difficult, and here you have a cool means of entertainment, virtually harmless, well, most likely.

Polished Infusion: needs 64 Aversio drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.dematerializat:
Long harness, but quickly goes

After many sleepless nights, you have a hunch that these rifts are not as dangerous as you first thought. Although they look quite impressive and are breaches in space itself, this does not negate the fact that what has been destroyed can be rebuilt. In this case, the material for restoring the fabric of space can serve as aura in its purest manifestation. That is, it is necessary to somehow direct a large amount of Auram aspect to the rift, after which the spatial rift will begin to fade. Perhaps the vis conductor's focus can handle this task. You just need to modify it a bit...
This upgrade allows vis to be pointed at living creatures. Vis causes some damage and dematerializes creatures into ethereal essence.
research.thaumicconcilium.destabilized_c:
I can't believe this is not jar!

Liquid essence is a little difficult to keep ready for instant transfer. The way out is a crystallized essence that is stable enough not to melt and active enough to be quickly converted, why you didn't figure it out yourself?
Press RMB with the desired essence crystal on the cluster to build it up, then start the infusion process and grab the cluster with the conductive focus.
If everything goes according to plan, the collected essence will be thrown into the infused object.
Feed a cluster crystallized essentia by hand, one at a time: the first sets its aspect, each of that aspect adds one. It holds what it is given; break it and it is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.dreamwood_brac:
Latest trend in Elven Fashion

Not all elves are able to carry heavy staffs, so these bracelets are quite popular in Elvengard. The bracelet retains all the transformative properties of the staff of the Dreamwood.
It holds 50 vis and refills from my mana items as the livingwood one does.
research.thaumicconcilium.dump_jackboots:
You were able to create a new milestone in the construction of columns, towers, pillars, and just plain shapeless piles.
When these boots are put on your feet, they are capable of taking a block from your hands and dumping it out under you, all you have to do is bend your knees slightly.
You can try to put something under you when you fall, though risky journeys and acrobatic etudes are not the specialty of these boots.

Sneak with a block in hand and the boots lift me steadily upward, laying the block beneath my feet as I rise.

Polished Infusion: needs 128 Motus drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.eldritch_brace:
It knows what I have seen

The more permanently the Outer Lands have marked me, the faster this bracelet refills, a little of every primal at a time, unless I am warded against warp. It holds 90 vis.

Worn on the wrist, it leaves both hands free: press the cast key (V unless I change it) to cast, hold it to channel or charge, and use the change-focus key with no wand in hand to choose its focus. Its casts cost two thirds of a wand's and cool down in half the time, but it holds far less vis.
research.thaumicconcilium.ethereal_manip:
You have already seen, many times over, that your mind is colossally superior to the semblances of thought activity that most of those you know are operated by. Experience suggests that you will soon need a more comprehensive way to harness the power of thoughts, so you have developed an enhancement for telekinesis technology.
With this focus, you can not only attract objects to you, but also move them away from you by holding Shift and scrolling the mouse wheel in the desired direction.
The focus can control projectiles as well.

While channelling, the dropped item or projectile you look at is held in the air in front of you. Turn the mouse wheel to draw it nearer or push it further, between one and sixteen blocks.

Polished Infusion: needs 128 Desidia drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.fallen.botanis:
It's no secret that beauty is one of the reasons why the Magic of Nature finds its followers. However, death is an integral part of nature, so Botanists don't waste their time searching for immortality during their short lives.
Who knows, maybe they're right about something...

thaumicconcilium:textures/gui/withered_botanist.png:0:0:255:255:.5
research.thaumicconcilium.fallen.stage_0:
This is not what you expected.
Sure, you've already encountered representatives of the human race who have fallen to the bottom of madness before, but this.... Is this the fate that sooner or later awaits all those who have managed to live long enough, keeping thaumaturgical secrets? Despite all precautions, is your immortal soul worth the might that a practicing thaumaturge can achieve?
You don't feel like giving answers to these questions. Time will reveal your choice.
research.thaumicconcilium.fallen.stage_1:
Still, now is not the time to forget the mundane. You may be incapable of helping these people regain their past lives, but you can still deliver them from their current, um, form of existence, at least if you find yourself in such a situation, you would like the same to be done for you.

On the path of magic, many are so dazzled by their initial successes that they begin to think they can do anything.
But real challenges quickly reveal what one is truly worth for, and yet another conqueror of the Netherworld becomes material for the sand of souls.

thaumicconcilium:textures/gui/nether_explorer.png:0:0:255:255:.5
research.thaumicconcilium.fallen.title: The Price of scientific advances
research.thaumicconcilium.hex_of_predict:
Interdimensional leash

Paradoxically, even what was hitherto an emptiness to you in its most obvious manifestation no longer seems so.
Something must be the source of the aggressive effects generated by these anomalies, maybe you will figure it out later...
Today you found yourself at the bottom of this world, sprawled on bare stones, scratching runes into them. After recovering from another stroke, you hurried home to put down on paper what you felt. Whether it was a cosmic revelation, or the consequences of asphyxiation from lack of oxygen at such a depth, you do not remember.

According to your last assumption, with this construction, it becomes possible to more or less control what is on the other side of the rifts. It was too difficult to compete with the mature instances of them, and you couldn't be bothered with rock-cutting under the bombardment of unfriendly magic. However, you managed to conquer a young rift formed by unsealing aura nodes right in the center of the structure.
This rift is no longer dangerous, it's time to make the most of it...

Eight ancient stone around a bedrock block, struck with a wand (100 ordo and 100 terra): the Hex. A jarred node set on its centre and struck again unseals into a young rift, chained above it. Condensers send it essentia; throw one item onto the hex and wait while the runes burn: the rift remakes it, if I know how. Void slag keeps it hot; too hot and the rift collapses.
The same ring around a Barrier Stone makes a lesser hex (50 and 50). It cannot open a rift, but it calms a flux rift hanging above it: no more growth, no more taint when it closes, and it will remake things too, for twice the essentia. Keep the rift three blocks or more above the ring, or it eats what I throw.
The main thing is not to mix it up

A few minor design tweaks and a creative invention becomes a destructive weapon. Taking into account traumatic experience of your colleagues, You tried to strengthen the shell of the energy clot so that the explosion would not happen in your own hands.
It seems to work.
Most of the time.
research.thaumicconcilium.infernal_brace:
Power of Netherworld on your wrist

This heat-radiating bracelet is the symbol of a powerful lord over the Netherworld, but each time in history it was unclear whether it was the Netherworld or the emerged emperor who really ruled over it.
It holds 35 vis, and draws fire from the Nether as an infernal wand does.
research.thaumicconcilium.lithographer.s:
Body modification for health aware

Time is precious, and spending it pulling out gadgets and staring at meter output is clearly not your thing. The revelation goggles were a big leap forward from the thaumometer, but you decided not to rely on any devices to monitor the well-being of your friends.
This construction will allow you to perform a never before seen medical procedure - piercing a hole in your retina into a void. The operation itself makes little sense, so you've added support for a system of monitors as a sort of "lens".

To perform the operation, the machine needs 32 fractions of Sensus vis, supplied by a vis condenser located above the lithographer. The operation will begin as soon as you lie down on the bed.
Of course, sometimes you need to give your head a break from the deluge of information. You've created a way to counteract the effects of thaum-medical procedures through this drops. Overdose has the opposite effect.

Build it with a wand (100 ignis, 100 ordo, 50 aqua, 100 aer): over the head of a bed set a thaumium block, with a block of gold either side of it and either side of the bed, in a line along one axis; stand an Alchemical Construct on the thaumium block and strike it with the wand. The Lithographer takes the thaumium block's place. Four Astral Monitors that are watching someone go in its slots. A redstone signal starts it: it needs a Vis Condenser directly above it, a destabilized crystal of sensus holding at least 32 above that, and someone asleep in the bed.

Coagulating Eye Drops (a phial of sensus, 4 perditio, 2 sensus, 2 victus in a crucible) switch the sight off and on again.
research.thaumicconcilium.livingwood_bra:
Elegant and Natural solution

You have succeeded in designing a bracelet out of livingwood. Like the original rod, the bracelet is capable of restoring Vis with mana.
You know for sure that it is possible to achieve more.
It holds 30 vis, and while I wear it, it refills from the mana tablets and rings I carry, six mana for every hundredth of a vis.
research.thaumicconcilium.mad_thaumaturg:
Poor souls lost

These ragamuffin-wearing lunatics must have lost the last link to reality.
It's unlikely that you can help them; apparently the weight of forbidden knowledge has finally squeezed their brains, and they attack you as soon as they see you, probably copying the habits of the living corpses among whom they roam.
That doesn't mean they're useless, however; you've seen notes from some of them that they made when they were still sane.

Some of these undoubtedly delusional ideas seem curious to you nevertheless, the main thing is not to run into the tipping point that forced them to leave human society.thaumicconcilium:textures/gui/mad_thaumaturge.png:0:0:255:255:.5
research.thaumicconcilium.nether_membran:
Just in time

You have come across some curious organic material. The most reasonable explanation you can think of is that this tissue was produced by the deceased, but it is impossible to say for sure.
Despite its adaptability, the material is highly fire-resistant. It is not enough to protect your body, but you can wrap your belongings in it to make them fireproof and lava-proof.
Wrapping anything in the membrane at a crafting table, one item at a time, leaves it proof against fire and lava.
research.thaumicconcilium.positive_burst:
The healing modification of the Pech's Curse focus resulted in the loss of its ability to affect others.
However, you were able to bring it back. This focus is able to materialize concentrated life energy, which can be absorbed by those in need.
Even though the process was quite expensive, it is better to let the Universe take material values than the lives of your friends.
research.thaumicconcilium.primordial_lif:
Holding this thing in your hands is tuggingly pleasurable.
This feeling is new to you, so first of all you tried to throw it off, thinking that it enslaves you, but after standing for a few seconds you realized that it is just the opposite.
Now your intentions are clearer than ever, and your will to fulfill it is unshakable. With this energy you can change the world and, without a doubt, yourself.
research.thaumicconcilium.quicksilver_cr:
Alchemical Miracle

To this day, no one had ever been able to create a way of merging essences. It seemed that this law of reality would never be broken.
But at last that day has come.
You have always believed that the will of man is boundless, and here it is, another confirmation of that. Having managed to capture one of those losers who in a past life thought they were expert alchemists, you threw him right into the boiling crucible.

The active structure of his body reacted violently, instantly fusing with the walls of the crucible, giving him a new, more useful purpose in life - to assist the more adaptable thaumaturges in their alchemical experiments.
For every fraction of mercury melted in this reactor, in one crucible within eight blocks, the first two fractions of the essence would be combined with each other.

Throw quicksilver into the reactor to feed it (each fraction is two points of permutatio, up to sixty-four); a redstone signal pauses it, and a comparator reads how full it is. Creatures standing in the mercury are burned.
research.thaumicconcilium.reflection_foc:
You've seen a lot in your life: dark caves, the scorching heat of the Nether, terrifying monsters, how can you sleep at night after that?
Your list of plans for the future clearly does not include ending up as one of those maniacs who roam among the walking corpses and throw themselves on people.

Fortunately (or unfortunately...), one of those who have suffered such a fate, at a certain point thought about where it goes (although he did not have time to do anything about it), you can not let such a thing go to waste.
With a little added element for reliability in the blueprints, you think that this device can rid you of visions of the past. You put the rod to your temple, and relax your eyes...

While channelled, the focus drains experience and turns it into temporary warp. Tuned to Oblivion it takes research instead: a point of some compound aspect you know, forgotten for a larger dose of warp.

Polished Infusion: needs 256 Vinculum drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.rifts.stage_0:
Whoa! Wha...?

What I saw was frighteningly disgusting and incredibly beautiful at the same time. The very fabric of the universe had been torn apart by the distortion, creating a hole in space that led to... I don't know where yet. I did not venture inside, and when I tried to get too close, it began to reject me, injuring me. Outside, all I could see was a bottomless void. I can't believe distortion can affect reality so much. This discovery suggests that spatial rifts can be exploited. Well, how?
research.thaumicconcilium.rifts.stage_1:
It was also discovered that aura nodes are also kind of rifts, but have a much more stable structure. However, this can be easily changed by simply trying to break them. During this process, their structure begins to lose its stability, which eventually leads to the appearance of a spatial rift.

A rift torn from a node grows, lashes out at whatever lives near it, and taints the ground as it closes. The rifts that flux tears open are kin to it, if calmer.
research.thaumicconcilium.rifts.title: Rifts
research.thaumicconcilium.ring_of_bluste:
There it is, shining, the perfect receptacle of your power for all to see from afar.
An artifact of astonishing, even for the current moment, power.
Combining all the light you have seen in your life and the material manifestations of the lower world, you have created this, the key to the very act of changing the reality around you. It is unlikely that you will ever think of removing it.
Aside from this little thing, the ring is capable of energizing your wands and giving excellent rune protection.

Worn as a ring, it carries a deep runic shield and feeds raw primal vis into the wand on my belt. Only with it on can I command the Spotlight, the Alchemist's Spree and Warp Extraction.

Polished Infusion: needs 512 Tenebrae drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.runic_windings:
In the pockets of one of the madmen who attacked you, you found a description of an exotic way to increase your rune defense.
The materials used are obviously not durable or physically defensive in any way. You assume that was not the intent in the design of this, ahem, outfit. Regardless, its enchantment potential is quite impressive.
You sometimes get cramps when you think of what, or who, it was meant to protect against.
Each winding holds a great runic charge, refills the shield faster than any rune I know and eases the cost of vis by three parts in a hundred.
research.thaumicconcilium.scribing_focus:
Tracking the state of your friends' defenses in combat is difficult, so you need a way to be sure before things turn fatal, for example, to help them... replenish their rune protection? Yes, this foci should do the trick.
After some training, you've learned to output runes at a more or less steady rate, now you need to learn not to lose the one whose defense you're replenishing in the hustle and bustle of combat.

Channel a beam onto an ally to restore their runic shielding, two points (plus potency) each pulse, never beyond what their runic gear can hold. The runes cannot be written on yourself.

Polished Infusion: needs 128 Fabrico drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.shard_mill.sta:
You have successfully mastered the technology of focusing vis streams with the help of infused crystals, but it seems to you that the magic accumulated in these crystals could be used more rapidly and widely.
To this end, you have constructed a handheld mechanism that crushes elemental shards into fine dust, allowing the magic to interact with world around it at a rapid rate.

§nAir Shard§r
Dust creates disturbances in the atmosphere that provoke a lightning strike.
§nFire Shard§r
Disruption of the crystal lattice causes a sudden release of fire magic in the form of an explosion.
§nWater Shard§r
Ice dust penetrates deeply into the soil, fertilizing it.

§nEarth Shard§r
Elemental earth disintegrates evenly into ordinary dirt.
§nEntropy Shard§r
Particles of entropy, when inhaled, cause living things to suffer a withering syndrome.
§nOrder Shard§r
Particles of order exert a pressure on living beings commensurate with their bad intentions.
§nBalanced Shard§r
A balanced shard grinds into the purest bits of vis.

Sneak and use the mill to open or close its lid. With the lid open, hold use to tip in a shard of the selected kind; with it closed, hold use to crank out the powder. Sneak and turn the mouse wheel to choose the shard.
research.thaumicconcilium.signal_focus.s: ...I can't, help me, it's so beautiful!

It may be safe to look for your colleagues under every rock, but it is still very ineffective, and it is silly and ridiculous to shriek at the whole neighborhood.
This invention is designed to eliminate all embarrassment by releasing compressed blasts of explosive energy into the air. It comes with colors for all seasons, and there is a touch of chaos for the unconventional individual.
Press Shift+RMB to change color
research.thaumicconcilium.silverwood_sha:
Your greatwood mill proved to be no match for the concentrated emanations of the Nether World, so you thought about upgrading it.
The cleansing properties of silverwood do an excellent job of grinding up those filthy shards, the dust of which produces some not-so-pleasant (from what angle you look at it) effects on whatever gets hit.

§nWrath Shard§r
Dust of Wrath causes contacted individuals to erupt in a blazing fury, draining both physical and magical powers.
§nLust Shard§r
The most heinous of outgrowths crawl from the bowels of the earth onto Lust pieces.
§nGluttony Shard§r
In the form of Gluttony dust, the nutritional properties of the crystal can be divided into equal portions.

§nSloth Shard§r
Under the influence of this dust, living creatures are rendered incapable of movement and magical manipulation.
§nEnvy Shard§r
Envy dust tends to spread, transforming near-flying projectiles into itself.
§nPride Shard§r
Pride dislodges all those who happen to be nearby from itself.

§nGreed Shard§r
The vibes of Greed, bursting out of the crystal, pull towards itself everything it reaches.
§nTaint Shard§r
Taint dust causes severe poisoning on contact, but endured bodies of thaumaturges are able to neutralize this effect, at the cost of temporary mental confusion.
research.thaumicconcilium.spotlight_focu:
A simple, yet active way to utilize your new power. Fail-safe, reliable, guaranteed.
Effort must be made to recalibrate the fire focuses, but these are minor details compared to the final product.
In this iteration, the focus provides virtually unlimited support in fuming your enemies.
Sure, the world is already waiting for your decisive help, but it can clearly hang on a little longer.

The beam's heat grows the longer it is held, and ignores armour. Letting go leaves the focus too hot to use for a while, longer the longer it burned. Warming Up turns it into a healing ray; Taint Purification cures tainted creatures, scorches the corrupted and scrubs taint from the ground. Requires the Ring of Blustering Light.

Polished Infusion: needs 1024 Perditio drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.taint_animatio:
You must have enslaved just about everyone you could by now. And now that list has expanded even further.
A strange, mangled, wrong parody of the life of the tainted lands now bends to your will. You have the power to tell it who to corrode, to pit it against each other, and even to stir up inactive forms of taint, creating swarms of gas and tentacles of fiber.

You firmly believe that you yourself will never wallow in the filth enough to become a pawn in someone else's fight.

Hold down the RMB to revive a nearby fibers or toxic cloud.
Hold a RMB while sneaking to indicate to all corrupted who to attack

In the focal manipulator the part can be fixed to animating or commanding alone. Flux Vaporization boils flux goo into gas; Thought Manifestation twists mind spiders into taint spiders.

Polished Infusion: needs 256 Infernum drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.tainted_bracel:
Don't forget to wash your hands

Voluntarily going to live in tainted lands is a strange decision in itself, but you'd still like to reduce direct contact with a corrosive environment, this compact bracelet should do the trick.
It holds 35 vis, and feeds on taint as a tainted wand does.
research.thaumicconcilium.terrasteel_bra:
Hit and Run

The terrasteel caps were a complete failure. Many sleepless nights were spent searching for a workaround. It was necessary to create a passageway for Vis without compromising the durability of the material - the Earth Goddess herself had to help.
You sacrificed everything: the storage capacity, the price of mana recharge, the amount of Vis needed to overcome the terrasteel caps. Apparently, you overdid it. The resulting bracelet is still voracious and tight, but as soon as the barrier is overcome - a veritable river of Vis rushes from your hand, almost instantly emptying the charge.

It holds 50 vis and refills from mana at twenty mana for every hundredth of a vis. Every instant spell it casts fires ten times over, each at three times a plain wand's price, and the cooldown triples.
research.thaumicconcilium.thaumaturges.s:
We live in a society

Sitting cooped up at home all day long, looking for ways to conquer the essence of things is quite exhausting.
It is unlikely that the whole world is concentrated under your nose, so sharing experiences with other obsessives like you should come in handy. Offer them your ideas and they will share theirs with you.
Nor will they refuse to trade occult or ancient junk from your pockets for theirs, but that's not why you've come all the way out here, is it?

thaumicconcilium:textures/gui/thaumaturge.png:0:0:255:255:.5

Now they will talk to me. Offered something they value at the trade table (mana beans, skulls, wands, bottles o' enchanting, enchanted books) they lay out what they feel it is worth. A finished research note interests them most: in exchange they share an idea of their own.
research.thaumicconcilium.thaumdrum.stag:
Spirits of The Land

You have managed to restore, piece by piece, long-lost knowledge. According to your calculations, at least twenty generations have passed since these papers were written, maybe without your participation this information would have been lost forever.
Using some ethereal essence, you were able to connect the note block with the aura of the surrounding world, but it is not known whether it reacts from admiration of your musical talent, or from irritation caused by the noise you generate.
The main thing in the role of the bard is not to be killed by members of your own squad.

Hold the use key to play it: a bass beat every second of a second and a half, and every one and a half seconds a wisp of a random primal aspect answers the call, until sixteen roam within sixty-four blocks. They are not grateful.
research.thaumicconcilium.tight_belt.sta:
And who would wear it? By perverting the lightweight nature of the thaumostatic girdle, you have achieved the opposite effect - instead of a slight lift, the girdle will squeeze your insides as tightly as it can.
You've noticed that the clearer the genius idea in your head about taking off that damn piece of leather, the weaker the belt twists your guts.

While I carry temporary warp it squeezes me with Thaumarhia, and slowly wrings the warp out of me, leaking flux gas as it does.

Polished Infusion: needs 128 Volatus drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
Delegating dangerous interactions

Accumulating, controlling, and releasing titanic amounts of vis with your own hands is dangerous and tedious. To solve this problem, you have been able to adapt the technology of spatial rift dematerialization, for use in ordinary machines.
This vis capacitor is capable of instantly releasing a vis charge in the direction opposite to the side from which the red stone signal came. The strength of the signal is directly proportional to the distance to be discharged, and inversely proportional to the power of that discharge.

The energy for operation is supplied to the capacitor through the destabilized crystal cluster located on it. A single use spends 16 parts of stored vis.

A signal from below sends the whole charge into a Hex of Predictability holding a rift within eight blocks.
research.thaumicconcilium.vis_conductor_:
FUBAR, as planned

The infusion process is a well-trodden path for you. And although the possibilities of infusion are almost limitless, they seem somehow, well, one-sided, if only you could not only add something missing to the subject, but also take out something unnecessary and interfering...
This thought was floating in your head for a long time, but you could not catch and formalize it, and it's good that there was more than one such obsessive person in the whole world.

In fact, everything is simple enough, you just need to put a certain final touch, to hit the essence of unnecessary property on the object while the magical circlulations have not subsided and it is still hot, thus knocking out of it such a thing.
For such a blow, this focus, which has the ability to absorb and release at the right moment the power of the essence, will help you.
All you need is a suitable vessel.

Channelled at a destabilized crystal cluster, it draws the cluster's charge into itself; what happens when I let go depends on where I point it, and on the upgrade I set in the focal manipulator: Dematerialization, once I understand rifts, or the Wisp Launcher, which reels in a wisp and flings it, charged.
Nothing, worn close

Void metal drinks vis less greedily than thaumium. A band of it holds 27 vis.

Worn on the wrist, it leaves both hands free: press the cast key (V unless I change it) to cast, hold it to channel or charge, and use the change-focus key with no wand in hand to choose its focus. Its casts cost two thirds of a wand's and cool down in half the time, but it holds far less vis.
research.thaumicconcilium.warp_extractio:
Using magic requires what? Payment? Yeah, what's more, put your pocket wide open. The eternal "equal this, consequences that". Sometimes it seems that having only noise in my head and waving off hallucinations is a hundred times better than listening to this whining. I need, need, have to... I have to get that delusional part out of me, and I've already had one successful experience with meddling in the insides of my own skull... Mostly successful, I don't seem to remember about... about..?
Take it out and throw it away, so simple, but something prevents, something is missing...

Channel to draw out the charge; it needs temporary warp, which Reflection can supply. Keep channelling to hold it before you and release to hurl it. Start channelling while sneaking to dismiss it. Its touch hurts in proportion to my lasting warp, burning a point of temporary warp each time. Requires the Ring of Blustering Light.

Polished Infusion: needs 512 Victus drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.warpdrum.stage:
Head of Spiders

You've already gotten the Aura to respond to certain sounds, now it's time to try something new.
Many believe that the human mind is as complex as the world we inhabit. If their assumptions are correct, perhaps you can get something useful out of your cranium? You'll need the proper tools to deal with your mental mess, but that's not even an obstacle anymore.

Throw a Thaumaturge's Drum onto a Hex of Predictability whose rift holds 128 sensus, 128 perditio, 64 cognitio, 64 bestia and 64 vitium. Played, the Warped Drum calls a harmless mind spider every half second, up to sixteen within thirty-two blocks.
research.thaumicconcilium.warpdrum.title: Warped Drum
research.thaumicconcilium.wrath_attracti:
Defeats in battles "pile vs pile" have made you realize that your squad needs to up its tactical interaction.
However, simply chipping in with good gear for the densest member of your squad wasn't enough; even the undead aren't always stupid enough to switch from gnawing off your unprotected limbs to clearly someone impregnable to their teeth.
The solution lies in the depths of the underworld. By confining the essence of this cursed place in gem, you are able to control the creatures' wrath by turning it on itself.

Every hostile creature nearby turns its anger on the target: on yourself when cast directly, or on whoever a delivery strikes. Reach widens the call; Burnout leaves the embittered creatures weakened.

Polished Infusion: needs 128 Cognitio drawn from a Destabilized Crystal with a Vis Conductor, held as the infusion completes; without it the result is lost.
research.thaumicconcilium.xylography.sta:
Magical signature

You've come up with a simple and elegant way to sign your wand by giving it your name. You can hand them out at your fan meetings!
To apply the xylography, simply place the wand in a craft grid.
spell.thaumicconcilium.alchemist_spree.d: Re-forges projectiles that reach you and fires them along your aim. Needs the Ring of Blustering Light.
Launches a clot of compressed energy that flies straight and bursts in mid-air when its fuse runs out.
spell.thaumicconcilium.ethereal_manipula: Holds the item or projectile you look at in mid-air. Mouse wheel adjusts the distance.
spell.thaumicconcilium.flurry.desc: Throws snowballs, or fragile frost shards. Best channelled.
spell.thaumicconcilium.flurry.name: Flurry
spell.thaumicconcilium.impulse.desc: Detonates where it lands. Can instead be tuned into a pneumatic strike that spares blocks and hurls creatures away.
spell.thaumicconcilium.impulse.name: Impulse
spell.thaumicconcilium.positive_burst.de: Materialises motes of life energy that seek out nearby players other than you and heal, fortify or invigorate them.
spell.thaumicconcilium.reflection.desc: Trades experience (or forgotten research) for temporary warp.
spell.thaumicconcilium.reflection.name: Reflection
spell.thaumicconcilium.scribing.name: Scribing
spell.thaumicconcilium.signal.desc: A harmless, colourful firework burst, so your allies can find you. Can be made dazzling.
spell.thaumicconcilium.signal.name: Signal
spell.thaumicconcilium.spotlight.desc: A searing, armour-piercing heat that builds while held. Needs the Ring of Blustering Light.
spell.thaumicconcilium.spotlight.name: Spotlight
spell.thaumicconcilium.taint_animation.d: Raises taintacles and swarms from fibres and flux gas, or sets tainted creatures on a victim.
spell.thaumicconcilium.vis_conductor.des: Channel at a destabilized crystal cluster to draw its charge, then let go at a target. Letting go at nothing bursts the cluster. Dematerialization turns the charge on creatures, and an auram charge on rifts.
spell.thaumicconcilium.warp_extraction.d: Draws a harmful charge of warp out of your mind. Needs the Ring of Blustering Light.
Turns every nearby hostile creature against the target.
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.no_more: Hmm. I'm afraid, it will be difficult for me to surprise you this time.
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.taunt.0: Why are you mooing? Can you even read?
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.taunt.2: You can talk when you've learned at least something.
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.taunt.3: Oh, lovely. They've sent me a mo-ron.
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.trade.1: Maybe you can take a look?
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.trade.2: I was thinking about that a lot lately.
thaumicconcilium.thaumaturge.trade.3: Glad that finally got rid of it. My head can no longer endure that.
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.destcrysta: Only a fool will build that out of essentia itself, let alone activating it...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.impulse: Genuinely a bad idea, but must be trivial to finish...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.mad_comple: These lunatics can't possibly know anything worthy anymore.
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.positivebu: Hm, Pechs should know more about organism alterations...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.reflection: Hm, the only things missing are a method of experience exchanging and a brain contact scheme...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.thicktaint: He really brewed this thing? Gross. However...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.visconduct: It seems that one must master both channelling and splitting Vis streams...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.hint.windings: Horrific, you need to come up with more suitable ink for these runes...
thaumicconcilium.tooltip.polishment: Right click on Rift to remove it.
